services.desc: Looking for a location to host your next party or corporate event? Are you a coach needing indoor space to hold team practice or a strength training session? Or maybe you’re looking for a Strength and Conditioning coach and program for your entire team. Here at Mission CrossFit San Antonio, we are available for hourly and half-day facility rentals. Having 12,000sf of floor space and being San Antonio’s largest indoor CrossFit/Strength and Conditioning Facility as well as one of the cities largest indoor multi-use facilities, we are able to provide a top-notch facility that can suit almost any need.
